paraphrase: Apps handling children's data must follow children's privacy law; birthdate and parental contact may be asked only for that compliance; apps mainly for kids carry no third-party analytics or advertising except under the Kids Category terms; an app that collects or can share a minor's personal information must have a privacy policy; and an app outside the Kids Category may not use any words or images in name, subtitle, icon, screenshots or description that imply children are its main audience.
quote: Apps not in the Kids Category cannot include any terms in app name, subtitle, icon, screenshots or description that imply the main audience for the app is children
